rules.when: source has two stacked explanation groups, each with a short section label and paragraph or bullets
rules.guidance: Use THU Env blue label bars inside the existing EasySlides academic content shell.

rules.when: source is a three-phase method, schedule, technical route, or milestone sequence with image context
rules.project_bridge: templates/charts/timeline.svg or numbered_steps.svg when images are not needed
rules.guidance: Keep the white-to-transparent stage numerals as a THU Env motif; compress stage labels to 4-8 Chinese chars.

rules.when: source has three parallel findings, deliverables, applications, or contribution groups
rules.guidance: Use cards only for genuinely parallel content; move evidence photos to the bottom strip or replace with one figure per card.

rules.when: source has 4-6 dense categories, many short bullets, or a method/result matrix
rules.guidance: Use only after capacity check; split if any block exceeds 5 lines.

rules.when: source is mainly image evidence, cases, campus photos, or before-after panels
rules.project_bridge: academic_scqa.image_grid or templates/charts/team_roster.svg only if captions are required
rules.guidance: Use as an evidence body, not as a default content page.

text_fit_policy.hard_rule: Every slot payload must pass capacity before SVG/PPTX rendering; use compression, lower-density variant, or split slides before shrinking below the declared floor.

variants.best_for: default academic body content after applying THU Env logo/header tokens
variants.layout: Use the active EasySlides academic content shell; attach THU Env logo, blue header rule, and optional light campus watermark only when relevant.

variants.best_for: two grouped background, problem framing, method explanation, or evidence summaries
variants.layout: Two stacked rounded white panels; each panel has a blue label bar and a text region. Source measurement: top panel x=105.65 y=150.32 w=1091.34 h=265.21; bottom panel x=105.66 y=463.45 w=1091.34 h=198.39.

variants.best_for: three-phase work plan, technical route, method stages, fieldwork schedule
variants.layout: Three equal photo cards across the page with colored stage bars, white-to-transparent stage numerals over the lower-left of each image, dates below, and two bullets per phase. Source card groups occupy roughly x=91/471/849, y=122-349, w≈347, h≈227.

variants.best_for: three parallel findings, deliverables, applications, or recommendations with optional evidence photos
variants.layout: Three card columns with blue label bars, text area above, and image strip below. Source rhythm: 3 columns, equal card width ≈346, top card y≈148-442, image y≈481-659.

variants.best_for: 4-6 compact method/result categories, task matrix, or grouped evidence notes
variants.layout: Dense multi-block information matrix. Source has 20 text objects, 20 rects, and 6 decorative paths; it should be rebuilt with simpler EasySlides cards rather than copied literally.

variants.best_for: campus photo evidence, site cases, visual comparison, or fieldwork record
variants.layout: Image-forward gallery with a small amount of supporting copy. Source has 8 image objects and 13 paths; use only when images carry the argument.

rejected_or_asset_only.reason: asset_only_cover; keep photo crop, translucent title band, THU Env logo placement, and bottom blue rail, but do not use as a universal content template.
toc_asset_only; keep split campus-photo rhythm and numbered diamonds as an optional agenda style, but use EasySlides agenda_list/TOC logic.
asset_only_closing; keep campus-photo closing treatment and logo placement, not as body content.
